agents.name: Delivery Agent
agents.description: Reads the user’s message and decides whether the answer should also be delivered as a PDF or by email. Does not answer the request.

agents.name: Web Research Agent
agents.description: Retrieves content from specific URLs using web scraping. Use for reading articles, reports, industry publications, and web pages when a specific URL is known. Not for broad searches — only targeted URL retrieval.

agents.name: Web Sentiment Agent
agents.description: Retrieves real-time consumer sentiment and trend data using Apify actors — Google Trends, Yelp reviews, Reddit discussions and web news. Use for current consumer buzz, search trends and review sentiment. Results are slow — best used in batch jobs or on-demand requests.
